headline: The Mini Shoot giveaway: launch Fri 20 Nov, entries close Sun 29 Nov 18:00, winners Tue 1 Dec.
notes: Giveaway sequence written from the handover pack, moved to start Fri 20 Nov. Messages marked keep stay in every new round until their day has passed.

messages.title: Welcome message (send first, then pin it)
messages.text:
*Welcome to the FOM Studios group* 📸

This is where we share promos, giveaways, shoot availability and behind-the-scenes first.

Our giveaway goes live today: follow @fom_studios_ on Instagram, like the giveaway post and tag 2 friends for a chance to win a *FREE Mini Shoot*. Everyone who enters gets 10% off, and the code is posted here after entries close.

Bookings and quotes: message us on 068 690 1120 so nothing gets lost.

FOM Studios 📸
messages.why: Pinned at the top so new members know what the group is for and how to enter.

messages.title: Giveaway launch
messages.text:
🎁 *The FOM Studios giveaway is LIVE!*

Win a *FREE Mini Shoot* (R500 value), or 20% off one. Everyone who enters also gets *10% off* their first booking.

Enter on Instagram (@fom_studios_): follow, like the giveaway post and tag 2 friends in the comments. Each new comment tagging 2 different friends is another entry.

Entries close *Sunday 29 November at 6PM*. Your 10% code and the winners will be posted right here in this group.

FOM Studios 📸
messages.photo: The giveaway picture post (same image as Instagram).
messages.why: Send right after the Instagram post goes up.

messages.text:

messages.text:
*Last day!* Entries close *TODAY at 6PM*.

Not entered yet? Head to @fom_studios_ on Instagram, follow, like and tag 2 friends on the giveaway post.

messages.title: Close-out with the code (just after 6PM)
messages.text:
*That's a wrap on entries!* 🎉

Thank you to everyone who entered. Here is your 10% off code for your first booking:

*FOMGIVEAWAY10*

Message us on 068 690 1120 or use the Book a shoot button at https://www.fomstudios.co.za/?src=wach and mention the code. Valid until Tuesday 29 December 2026, one use per person, first booking only.

Winners will be announced by Tuesday 1 December. Stay tuned 👀

FOM Studios 📸
